Overview.p: EC2 can use EBS volumes (network disks that persist) or Instance Store (disks on the host, lost when the instance stops or fails). EFS gives a shared file system.
EBS = a pen drive you can unplug and keep. Instance Store = scratch space inside the machine that is wiped when you give it back.
A database uses EBS gp3 for persistent data. A cache server uses Instance Store for very fast temporary files.

items: EFS is shared across many servers

Overview.p: EBS = Keep • Instance Store = Lose • EFS = Share
